recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-1960s album cover featuring a portrait of a male performer interacting playfully with a large bronze rabbit sculpture, set against a soft outdoor background with bold, stacked typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a textured bronze sculpture
Bold orange-red display type contrasting with a light blue sky
Tight cropping focusing on the interaction between human and statue
Analog film grain and slightly desaturated color palette
coreInvariants: Bronze sculpture with visible casting texture
Subject in a relaxed, expressive pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject and sculpture occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large bronze rabbit head on the right side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold orange text, move down to the subject's face, and follow his gaze to the sculpture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Light blue sky at the top provides a clean canvas for the primary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted bronze and earthy browns in the foreground sculpture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale sky blue in the upper third background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red used for the primary artist name.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text against a medium-value, low-saturation photographic base.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Artist name in thick, blocky slab serifs with tight kerning
Secondary text in all-caps condensed sans-serif
Tertiary text in smaller, centered italicized sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with a functional condensed sans-serif for information.
graphicDevices: Hexagonal logo container in the top left corner
Small technical metadata text in the corners

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thick slab-serif structure and mid-century feel.
Appropriate for the secondary all-caps information text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1960s-style color photograph of a man in a green shirt leaning against a large, textured bronze rabbit sculpture. The background is a soft-focus park with a pale blue sky. The lighting is natural and diffused.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large orange-red slab-serif title centered at the top. Below it, add two lines of black condensed sans-serif text, also centered. Place a small hexagonal logo in the top left and technical text like 'STEREO' in the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text a bold slab serif?
Is the color palette muted with one bright accent?
Is the composition centered and top-heavy?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the bronze texture looks metallic and cast, not plastic.
Verify the 'Stereo' text is in a small, clean sans-serif.
Confirm the orange-red color is vibrant but not neon.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a portrait of a subject interacting with a public monument, apply a 60s film filter, and overlay bold slab-serif typography in the upper third negative space.
